reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: Parathyroidectomy with nerve monitoring and IOPTH in a patient whose HCTZ was supposed to be stopped in 2025 but was auto refilled and taken this morning; calcium 11.9, iCa 1.54, short QTc, K 3.4, volume depleted, and severe PONV history.

asa.rationale: Primary hyperparathyroidism with hypercalcemia, HTN, obesity class I.

decision.rationale: Calcium below 14 without severe symptoms is not a reason to cancel; surgery is the cure. Hydrate with saline, correct potassium, fix the HCTZ medication error and tell the PCP and endocrinology.

redFlags.finding: HCTZ still taken despite being discontinued
redFlags.evidence: Endocrinology 06/2025 stopped HCTZ; refill auto approved 03/2026; PAT med rec lists it; taken 0700 today.
redFlags.action: Stop HCTZ, reconcile meds, notify PCP and endocrinology.

redFlags.finding: Hypercalcemia with ECG changes and dehydration
redFlags.evidence: Ca 11.9, iCa 1.54, QTc 328 short, dry mucosa, polyuria, K 3.4, BUN rising.
redFlags.implication: Arrhythmia, hypotension at induction, variable NMB response.
redFlags.action: Normal saline hydration, ECG monitoring, replete potassium, avoid hyperventilation-induced K drop.

redFlags.evidence: NIM EMG ETT 7.0; avoid long acting NMB after intubation.
redFlags.action: Succinylcholine or small rocuronium dose with sugammadex; no topical lidocaine on the tube; confirm tube position.

redFlags.evidence: PONV after GA in 2004 and 2024; female nonsmoker; morphine intolerance.
redFlags.action: Multimodal prophylaxis (dexamethasone, ondansetron, consider scopolamine or TIVA), avoid morphine.

redFlags.evidence: Dedicated R forearm IV, baseline then 5, 10, 15 min post excision.
redFlags.action: Draw from dedicated line on time.
Smooth emergence, check voice, calcium follow up.

planItems.item: NIM ETT 7.0 with video laryngoscopy placement
Cefazolin 2 g within 60 min of incision
Shoulder roll, arms tucked, protect osteoporotic bone
